delay.description: Queues the commands after the semicolon to run after the requested number of milliseconds without pausing unrelated command-buffer work.
delay.summary: Run following commands after a millisecond delay.

delaycancel.description: Cancels pending millisecond-based delay entries whose command text contains the supplied text. An empty string matches every pending delay.

ifcvar.description: Tests a cvar against conditions in order and executes the command belonging to the first match. Conditions support literal string equality; numeric $=, $!=, $>, $<, $>= and $<= comparisons; $contains; $beginswith/$startswith; $endswith; $else; and values read from another cvar with a leading $. The argument count includes the command itself.
ifcvar.summary: Execute a command selected by comparisons against a cvar.

mnext.description: Simulates the operating system next-track media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mnext.summary: Send the next-track media key on Windows.

mpause.description: Simulates the operating system play/pause media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mpause.summary: Send the play/pause media key on Windows.

mprev.description: Simulates the operating system previous-track media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mprev.summary: Send the previous-track media key on Windows.

mstop.description: Simulates the operating system stop-media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mstop.summary: Send the stop-media key on Windows.

strsub.description: Executes a command after replacing text surrounded by dollar signs with the value of that cvar. A doubled dollar sign emits one literal dollar sign.
strsub.summary: Execute a command with $cvar$ value substitution.

waitf.description: Queues the commands after the semicolon to run after the requested number of rendered frames without pausing unrelated command-buffer work.
waitf.summary: Run following commands after a frame-count delay.

waitfcancel.description: Cancels pending frame-based waitf entries whose command text contains the supplied text. An empty string matches every pending waitf.

cg_camerafps.description: Sets the emulated frame rate used to make third-person camera damping frame-rate independent. Values below 15 select the original JK2/JKA multiplayer damping path; values of 15 or more use the time-adjusted path, with the original response reproduced when the actual frame rate matches this value.
cg_camerafps.summary: Set the reference frame rate for third-person camera damping.

values.meaning: Use the original frame-rate-dependent JK2/JKA multiplayer camera damping.
Use frame-rate-independent damping based on this emulated frame rate.

sv_httpdownloads.description: Enables fast HTTP downloads for referenced PK3 files. When enabled, the server advertises either its built-in HTTP endpoint or the external URL configured by sv_httpServerPort to supporting clients.
sv_httpdownloads.summary: Enable the server's JK2MV-derived HTTP auto-download path.

values.meaning: Disable HTTP auto-download advertising and stop the built-in HTTP server.
Advertise HTTP downloads and start or redirect the HTTP endpoint.

sv_httpserverport.description: Configures the HTTP auto-download endpoint. A numeric value selects the built-in web server's port; a value beginning with http:// advertises that external base URL instead.
sv_httpserverport.summary: Set the built-in HTTP download port or an external HTTP URL.

cl_downloadprotocol.description: Reports the protocol selected for the active file download. The client sets this internal cvar to HTTP when the server advertised an HTTP endpoint and otherwise sets it to UDP.
cl_downloadprotocol.summary: Report whether the active download uses HTTP or UDP.

values.meaning: Download from the server's advertised HTTP endpoint.
Use the legacy in-protocol UDP download path.

r_dynamicglowbloom.description: Controls the rend2 dynamic-glow bloom strength. Zero skips the bloom pass; positive values up to the enforced maximum of 2 are passed to the high-pass shader as bloom strength.
r_dynamicglowbloom.summary: Set rend2 dynamic-glow bloom strength from 0 through 2.

values.meaning: Use this positive value, up to 2, as the shader's bloom strength.

cg_drawcrosshairnames.description: Controls target-name display below the crosshair. Zero disables it, negative values display a name only while the crosshair remains on the target, and positive values are the fade duration in seconds.
cg_drawcrosshairnames.summary: Set crosshair target-name display and fade duration.

values.meaning: Draw only while the crosshair is currently on the target; do not fade afterward.

cg_drawcrosshairnamescolours.description: Selects crosshair-name coloring. Zero strips player color codes and uses green for allies and red for enemies; one preserves name color codes and starts from white.
cg_drawcrosshairnamescolours.summary: Choose team-aware or player-name crosshair colors.

values.meaning: Use green/red ally/enemy colors and sanitize name color codes.
Preserve color codes in player names.

cg_drawcrosshairnamesopacity.description: Multiplies the target-name fade alpha by this opacity. Runtime use clamps the effective value to the inclusive range 0 through 1.
cg_drawcrosshairnamesopacity.summary: Set crosshair target-name opacity from 0 to 1.

cg_movementkeys.description: Selects the movement-input overlay style, including classic, attack-aware, and movable crosshair layouts.
cg_movementkeys.summary: Select the on-screen movement-key overlay style.

r_drawfog.description: Controls fog rendering. The Vulkan registration documents 0 as disabled, 1 as software fog, and 2 as hardware fog; the same cvar is registered by vanilla, rend2, Vulkan, and the dedicated renderer stub.
r_drawfog.summary: Select disabled, software, or hardware fog rendering.
